# Astronomical 0.2.73
## Fixed
- Models stay fast on busy machines. The engine now locks model memory into physical RAM by default, so macOS pages other applications instead of the loaded model under memory pressure. First answers after loading a large model no longer stall for tens of seconds, and generation keeps its normal speed while browsers, editors, and background services compete for memory. Set `ASTRONOMICAL_MLX_WIRED_CLAIM=0` to keep model memory swappable instead. - Long conversations no longer slow down turn after turn. Memory reservations now cover the thinking allowance plus a visible-answer reserve instead of the full maximum output a client may request, so warm model state is no longer discarded between turns of long agent conversations. - Hardened retained-conversation-state accounting against an overflow that could produce a wrong retention decision.
## Improved
- Expanded regression coverage for memory admission, reclamation, and residency planning, plus a new low-level performance probe for localizing model serving speed.
## Compatibility
- No configuration changes; existing installs upgrade in place and keep their models and state. Model output semantics and precision are unchanged.
## Distribution
- This release is signed with a Developer ID identity, notarized by Apple, and stapled. The disk image and the automatic-update feed are signed, and their SHA-256 digests are recorded in the release manifest before publication.
